sources.label: Morphe patches for CrimeRadar - premium bypass and modifications
sources.author: CrimeRadar
patch_list: Changes app name to 'CrimeRadar+' and tints the icon for easy identification.
Changes the app package name to allow installing alongside the original.
Adds a CrimeRadar+ debug info entry to the settings screen.
Raises per-category daily push caps and heads-up push limits.
Bypasses premium subscription checks to unlock all premium features.
Removes the 200-item local reading history limit.
Overrides daily replay listening time limits to unlimited.
Disables Instabug and Adjust telemetry SDKs for privacy.
